# arianet_load_balancer_service (Resource)

A listener (service) of a load balancer, managed with the `add_service`, `update_service` and `delete_service` actions. Import ID: `<load_balancer_id>/<listen_port>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_load_balancer_service" "http" {
  load_balancer_id = arianet_load_balancer.lb.id
  protocol         = "http"
  listen_port      = 80
  destination_port = 8080

  health_check = {
    protocol = "http"
    port     = 8080
    interval = 10
    timeout  = 5
    retries  = 3
    http = {
      path         = "/healthz"
      status_codes = ["2??"]
    }
  }

  http = {
    sticky_sessions = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `listen_port` (Number) Port the load balancer listens on. Changing it replaces the service.
- `load_balancer_id` (Number) Load balancer the service belongs to.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `http` or `https` (TLS passthrough).

### Optional

- `destination_port` (Number) Port on the targets. Defaults to the API's choice (the listen port).
- `health_check` (Attributes) Health check of the targets. Unset fields take the API's defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `http` (Attributes) Options of `http`/`https` services. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http))
- `proxyprotocol` (Boolean) Whether the PROXY protocol header is sent to targets.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<load_balancer_id>/<listen_port>`.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Optional:

- `http` (Attributes) HTTP options of an `http` check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check--http))
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `port` (Number) Port checked on the targets.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp` or `http`.
- `retries` (Number) Failed checks before a target is unhealthy.
- `timeout` (Number) Seconds before a check fails.

<a id="nestedatt--health_check--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check.http`

Optional:

- `domain` (String) Host header.
- `path` (String) Request path.
- `status_codes` (List of String) Accepted status codes, e.g. `["2??", "301"]`.
- `tls` (Boolean) Check over HTTPS (the certificate is not verified).



<a id="nestedatt--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http`

Optional:

- `cookie_name` (String) For http: the application's cookie to stick on. Empty: the load balancer sets its own.
- `redirect_host` (String) For https with `redirect_http`: the host clients are redirected to.
- `redirect_http` (Boolean) For https: answer plain http on port 80 with a redirect.
- `sticky_sessions` (Boolean) Keep a client on one target (cookie for http, source address for https).


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <load_balancer_id>/<listen_port>
terraform import arianet_load_balancer_service.http 21/80
```
